description.value: COBS Bread is a Canadian franchise bakery (part of the Australian Bakers Delight family) baking all products fresh from scratch on-site every day — no frozen or refrigerated goods. The Commercial Drive location on one of Vancouver's most vibrant neighbourhood corridors offers a wide range of breads, rolls, scones, cruffins, croissants, and savoury items including pizza-style products. Leftover baked goods are donated to local charities at day's end, a notable community practice.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wall_loops (3 spaces) at 42m; rack at 54m. Total: 3 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The COBS Bread store-finder page for Commercial Drive confirms the address (1748 Commercial Dr, Vancouver, BC V5N 4A5), phone (+1 604-216-2916), and regular operating hours, corroborating the OSM record. No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any of the optional amenity list — are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all such fields are null. The website and product pages confirm this is a fully operational franchise bakery selling fresh-baked breads, pastries, scones, cruffins, and savoury items daily.
concerns: Phone number (+1 604-216-2916) is present on the website but absent from OSM tags — OSM record should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible bakery on Commercial Drive confirmed by the brand's own store-finder page with a full address and phone number. Useful to touring cyclists as a food resupply point.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM maps shop=bakery to Groceries; a bakery is not a traditional grocery store but does sell packaged breads and ready-to-eat baked goods that touring cyclists can purchase, so the mapping is acceptable for directory purposes.
